question: Should this credential-separated, receipt-bound repair pipeline become ClawSweeper's production publication and recovery security boundary?
rationale: The patch is technically review-ready, but it intentionally changes privileged mutation authority and fail-closed operational behavior; tests cannot supply repository intent or rollout ownership.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Merge the reviewed head and monitor initial publication, rerun, closeout, and recovery executions with a defined rollback owner.

options.title: Split deployment
options.body: Land staged proof planning separately from credential, publication, and recovery workflow changes to reduce rollout scope.

options.title: Require live rehearsal
options.body: Keep the draft open until a production-like end-to-end repair and recovery run is captured.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Merge the reviewed head and monitor initial publication, rerun, closeout, and recovery executions with a defined rollback owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history shows the strongest ownership across the affected repair executor, validation, token, state, and workflow surfaces.
